description: Use this when the user asks for places, parks, sights, museums, beaches or things to visit in a city, region or near a point. Finds interesting places (sights, museums, parks, nature, beaches and more), ordered by popularity. Returns name, category, city, country, coordinates, distance, a link to the place page (url), a popularity score, a stored travel description and one verified photo with its credit (image, or null). For more about one place, call get_place with the last part of its url. Give q (a place, city or country name, optionally with a category, e.g. "valencia" or "zoo valencia"), or lat/lng of the area the user asks about, or both (q narrowed to radius_km around lat/lng). Optional filters: categories, needs, tastes, parking, setting; tags only rank matching places higher. Write each place name as a markdown link [name](url) when url is present, and show each place's url as the source link. When image is present, show image.url as a markdown image with the author credit. visit_minutes is the typical time visitors spend there, not the time to see everything. attributes gives the five needs as true (known yes) or null (unknown, never a no), and matched_needs lists which of the requested needs the place has. setting (indoor, outdoor, both or null) and parking ({free, paid}, each true or null) follow the same rule. matched_tastes and matched_tags list which of the requested tastes and tags the place hit. content_status is no_description when no travel description is stored; fallback_reason is translation_unavailable when lang differs from the requested one. With q, search_area shows the area q was read as. filter_semantics says how the filters combine.

categories.description: Only these categories. Empty means all.

detail.description: brief: summary and top tips. full: the whole stored description.

lang.description: Language of names and descriptions. Falls back to English per place.

lat.description: Latitude of the search center, decimal degrees. Required (with lng) unless q is given.

limit.description: How many places to return (max 20, or 5 with detail=full).

lng.description: Longitude of the search center, decimal degrees. Required (with lat) unless q is given.

needs.description: Practical needs every result must meet.

q.description: Free text: a city, country or place name, optionally with a category ("zoo valencia"). Required unless lat/lng are given.

radius_km.description: Search radius in km around lat/lng. Out-of-range values are clamped. Ignored without lat/lng.

tags.description: Free-text themes (e.g. "castle", "sunset"). They only move matching places up; nothing is excluded.

tastes.description: Who or what the place should suit.

name: find_places
title: Find places
